column1: # Iroha square, traditional seven-per-line layout; pair = row, column. 76 = dakuten, 77 = handakuten. ム also used for ン.

# Not a new key: the 1874 army 1-7 coordinate square is described by Nagata Junko (1989, p. 170), Ohno Tetsuya (2010) and Satoshi Tomokiyo (Cryptiana, meijiarmy.htm, 2014; his table "meijiarmy1"). Re-found here independently as an a-priori hypothesis (28 Oct 2026), before we knew of these works.
